en: A black-and-white postcard showing an artist at work in a studio. The artist, dressed in a smock and cap, bends over a paint table with palette and paint tubes. In the background are two large canvases with surreal paintings of nude, youthful figures seemingly carrying unusual organic shapes. The name 'Hugo Simberg' is printed at the bottom of the card, likely referring to the artist.
